Example: organisationid@1234$accountid@3333. Valid account identifiers are accountcategory, bankaccountno, accountrank, identityalias, iban, accountid, msisdn, swiftbic, sortcode, organisationid, username, walletid, linkref, consumerno, serviceprovider, storeid, bankname, bankaccounttitle, emailaddress, mandatereference.

params.name: limit
params.description: Supports pagination. If this is not supplied, then the server will apply a limit of 50 records returned for each request.

params.name: offset
params.description: Supports pagination. This value will indicate the cursor position from where to retrieve the set of records. For example, a limit of 50 and offset of 10 will return records 11 to 60.

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: Indicates the minimum creation date for which records should be returned.

params.name: toDateTime
params.description: Indicates the maximum creation date for which records should be returned.

params.name: codeState
params.description: Allows returned records to be filtered on state of the authorisation code.
